ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: in the figure is a schematic diagram of an animal cell; in the center of the cell there is a relatively large light-purple circular structure, and inside it there is a smaller dark-purple dot. The letter B is located on the left side of the cell, and its guide line points rightward into the central region, pointing to this large light-purple circular structure. Reasoning: in cell structure, the large membrane-enclosed circular organelle surrounding the smaller dark nucleolus is the nucleus. Therefore, the label corresponding to B is the nucleus.
